bibliographic.title: Οι ερωτήσεις μου - My questions
bibliographic.author: balthuk
bibliographic.description:
Ερωτήσεις που ήρθε η ώρα τους, επιτέλους.

Ό,τι βγει στο φως είναι δικό σου, ό,τι μείνει κρυφό θα'ναι δικό τους για πάντα.

----

Questions to be asked, at last.

What you reveal is yours, what you don't is theirs forever.

----

A series of questions - exclusively in Greek.

Made for Neo-Twiny Jam 2025

Vague relationship with Secrets, also made for  Neo-Twiny Jam 2025, written in Greek and translated to English.
